verses.3: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
verses.4: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
verses.5: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
verses.7: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
verses.9: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
verses.10: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
verses.11: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.12: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
verses.13: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for

verses.18: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
